title: Myanmar has been found guilty of genocide. Should Israel be worried? – podcast
summary_full: The international court of justice has for the first time ruled that a state has committed genocide. Yasmin Ullah explains what it means for the Rohingya people, while Kaamil Ahmed lays out how the case unfoldedFor seven years, Yasmin Ullah had been part of the delegation arguing that Myanmar had committed genocide – one of the gravest human rights crimes – against Rohingya Muslims.The genocide has directly affected Yasmin and her family. Last week she was in court to hear the international court of justice’s landmark verdict against Myanmar. “I was really kind of pinching myself. It felt like we were all able to breathe again,” she tells Annie Kelly. Continue reading...
